subject: Promotional credit syndication for Q3 accelerator cohort
messages:
From: Sue Kim <sue.kim@accelerateio.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Promotional credit allocation for Q3 cohort demo day

Hi Hannah —

Hope you had a great weekend. AccelerateIO is finalizing the Q3 demo day cohort and we have five startups that will be doing Redwood-powered prototypes as part of their curriculum. We talked on the phone last week about the possibility of Redwood sponsoring promotional credits for the cohort — the ask is $5,000 in total credits (to be distributed across the five companies) and a 60-day trial extension for any startups that have already started trials.

Attached: Accelerator_Cohort_Q3.xlsx (cohort list, company contact, expected demo use-case)

High-level timeline: demo day on 2027-09-15, prep workshops Aug 15–Sep 5.

Can Redwood approve partner-sourced promotional credits and confirm whether you want us to route these via Marketplace vouchers or through direct voucher codes you issue? We can accept either approach, but Marketplace routing helps us track uptake across the accelerator.

Happy to hop on a short call to align next steps.

Thanks —
Sue Kim
Head of Partnerships, AccelerateIO
sue.kim@accelerateio.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sue Kim <sue.kim@accelerateio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional credit allocation for Q3 cohort demo day

Thanks Sue — really appreciate you sending the cohort list. Short answer: we can support a partner promo allocation, but I want to loop in Marissa and Ben to align on the amount and fulfillment path (marketplace vouchers vs platform-issued codes).

Proposed immediate next steps from our side:
- Marissa to review cohort eligibility and channeling (marketplace vs direct).
- Ben to validate uplift and whether we should tie credits to trial-extension rules (expiration window / usage limits).
- Quick sync (15–20m) this week if convenient.

If marketplace routing is preferred by AccelerateIO we may need a 48–72 hour window to configure voucher SKUs and tracking. Otherwise we can issue direct promo codes and share a redemption spreadsheet.

Marissa / Ben — can you review the attached sheet when you get a chance and give a recommendation on credit amount and expiry? Sue — if you have a short preferred MOU or terms doc, please attach it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional credit allocation for Q3 cohort demo day

Looping in my notes after reviewing the cohort sheet and AccelerateIO ask.

My recommendation (to keep this predictable for finance and to limit over-commitment):
- Offer a $3,000 Redwood-sponsored promo pool (allocated as $600 per startup).
- Provide a 90-day trial extension for any startup that signs up prior to demo day.
- Credits expire 6 months after issuance.
- Prefer marketplace voucher routing for tracking and attribution; promo SKUs to be created under "AccelerateIO Demo Day Q3".

Ben — I need your take on revenue motion. If we treat this as marketing/partner spend, can finance cover the $3k as partner co-op? If not, we should document in the HubSpot deal and tag as "promo-credit" spend so the accounting bucket is clear.

Also attaching a short draft of promo terms so AccelerateIO can sign off quickly: promo_terms_draft.docx (very light — eligibility, expiration, non-transferable, reporting cadence).

If we all agree, Hannah please confirm and I'll open a HubSpot task and ping Marketplace team to create voucher SKUs (est. 72 hours).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sue Kim <sue.kim@accelerateio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.co
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional credit allocation for Q3 cohort demo day

Thanks Marissa — that sounds workable and we appreciate the clarity. AccelerateIO accepts the $3,000 pool and the 90-day extension as you've outlined. Marketplace SKU routing is preferred on our end.

Next actions from our side:
- I will countersign the short promo terms and return via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.
- Provide any missing billing contact info if required (I copied our partner ops mailbox partners@cloudbridge.co to help with fulfillment).

Can Redwood confirm an estimated date when voucher SKUs will be available so we can publish the event materials and registration form? If you can give me an ETA (even a rough one) that would be great — we aim to publish registration on Aug 10.

Thanks again — excited to highlight Redwood in the demo day tech lineup.

—
Sue
